scripts.test:rules:emulator: cd ../.. && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project gearguard-test 'bun run --cwd firebase/functions test:rules'
scripts.test:functions:emulator: bun run build && cd ../.. && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,functions --project gearguard-test 'sh firebase/functions/test/emulator-smoke.sh'
scripts.verify: bun run check && bun run test && bun run test:rules:emulator && bun run test:functions:emulator
scripts.serve: bun run build && cd ../.. && firebase emulators:start --only auth,firestore,functions
